title: dioscorea glandulosa
intro: Dioscorea glandulosa, commonly known as the Chinese yam, is a type of plant belonging to the Dioscoreaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Dioscorea glandulosa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as diosgenin, a steroid saponin known for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Additionally, the plant's bioactive constituents may also include other compounds like flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
